edition.title: ألف ليلة وليلة (مختارات)

basis: author died 1800: more than 70 years ago in every life-plus-70 jurisdiction
first published 1835: more than 95 years ago (US term expired) - first printed at Bulaq, Cairo, in 1835 from the 18th-century Egyptian recension
rights.notes: Anonymous traditional work. deathYear 1800 is an upper bound, not a recorded date: the Arabic text distributed here is the Egyptian recension that was complete by the late 18th century and first printed in 1835; nobody who contributed to it can have died within the last 70 years. The ar.wikisource transcription is partial: nights 1 to about 130 (volumes 1-3) and the closing tale of Ma’ruf the cobbler (volume 4); the separate Sindbad page duplicates its nights and is left out.
rights.statement: Public domain worldwide. مؤلف مجهول died in 1800 and the work was first published in 1835. Source: ar.wikisource.org transcription of the public-domain text.
